title: Thai Smoked Meat Kisir
description: A twist on the traditional Turkish dish, this recipe combines smoky flavors with the bold spices of Thai cuisine. A hearty and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: smoked meat (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Look for thinly sliced smoked meat at your local grocery store

ingredients.name: rice (uncooked)
ingredients.notes: Thai jasmine rice pairs well with the smoky flavors

ingredients.name: turkish kisir (crushed)
ingredients.notes: You can find kisir at some Middle Eastern grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for the best flavor

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality fish sauce for the best flavor

ingredients.name: chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Add as much or as little heat as you like

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lime juice adds brightness to the dish

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced smoked meat and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the meat and onion mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add the crushed kisir, fish sauce, chili flakes, and lime juice to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
